أتماسك (form VI)
# أَتَمَاسَكُ (ʔatamāsaku) /ʔa.ta.maː.sa.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
# أَتَمَاسَكَ (ʔatamāsaka) /ʔa.ta.maː.sa.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
# أَتَمَاسَكْ (ʔatamāsak) /ʔa.ta.maː.sak/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَاسَكَ (tamāsaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
